messages:
Jordan Li: Hey finance  I returned my rental car in Munich last night but the agency charged my personal card for a €90 'refueling fee' despite me filling the tank. The corporate card was declined at pickup due to an authorization block so I used personal card for the deposit. I can't find the fuel receipt from the gas station \\u2014 I probably tossed it. Any guidance on getting reimbursed or disputing the charge?
Maria Gomez: Sorry that happened. Two things: 1) For reimbursements we prefer the gas receipt + final rental invoice showing fuel charge. 2) If the receipt is lost, submit the lost-receipt form and include the rental agency final invoice and a short explanation. Manager approval will be required for lost receipts > €75.
Jordan Li: Ugh, the agency emailed a final invoice but it only lists a generic "fuel charge" €90 with no gas station details. I do have photos of the car fuel gauge at return and the final odometer pic the agent took with me. Will that help?
Carlos Ruiz: Ping from Travel Ops YI rental companies sometimes add a service fee on top of fuel. If you have the rental return photos and the agency invoice that helps. If they won't provide a breakdown, we can either reimburse the documented charge (with manager sign-off) or attempt a vendor dispute to get an itemized refund. Which do you prefer?
Jordan Li: Prefer reimbursed now (travel expense) then Travel Ops can pursue vendor refund. How do I get manager sign-off?
Maria Gomez: Please file an expense with: (1) rental final invoice PDF, (2) photos of fuel gauge/odometer, (3) a short note "Corp card declined at pickup; personal card used for deposit. Lost gas receipt; rental agency charged fuel fee €90." Tag it "travel - rental" and request "manager approval for lost receipt." We'll route to your manager for approval in the workflow. If approved, Finance will reimburse the €90 charge but will require you to cooperate if Travel Ops disputes with vendor and recovery occurs.
Jordan Li: Done. Submitted expense #R-2023-558 with attachments and flagged for manager approval. Thanks.
Travel Ops: We'll try to get the rental company to provide an itemized breakdown. If they can confirm the fee is €90 for fuel + €15 service fee, you may be reimbursed only for the fuel portion depending on documentation.
Finance Bot: Policy excerpt: "Lost receipts under €75: auto-approve with employee attestation. Lost receipts over €75 require manager approval and additional supporting documentation. Corp card pre-authorization failures should be noted; if corporate card was unavailable, unavoidable personal card fees (including vendor-imposed fuel charges) may be reimbursed pending documentation and manager approval." Link: https://intranet.redwood/fin/lost-receipts
Maria Gomez: I'll review once manager approves. If Travel Ops secures an itemized invoice, upload it and we may adjust the reimbursement. Thanks for flagging quickly :thumbsup:
